_comment: S308 topic feeds for learn_watch.py, on top of the medium/substack web_sources in config/sources.json. Medium tag feeds list only the newest 10 posts, and their RSS body is a teaser; learn_watch reads the full text from each post's author/publication feed. Measured 2026-09-26 (posts in 24h / 7d): ollama 3/10, local-llm 5/10, llm-inference 1/10, vllm 1/10, claude-code 10/10 (saturated: a daily poll sees only the newest 10), openai-codex 4/10, dgx-spark 1/4, mac-studio 0/1, self-improving-ai 0/3, quantization 1/7. Left out as broad and noisy: ai-agents, agentic-ai, claude, anthropic-claude, mcp-server (all 10/10 in 24h). Empty: nvidia-dgx, llama-cpp.
